capabilities: Import web and Kindle highlights as notes
Import AI summaries and bookmarks as metadata-rich notes
Sync items automatically on hourly, daily, or weekly schedules
Generate Bases database views for each source
Customize note layout and frontmatter with Handlebars templates
extras: Warns that data.json contains your access token and must be treated like a password when syncing or sharing the vault. Full page text for summaries is subject to Glasp's daily API request limits. Requires Obsidian 1.9.0+ for Bases views; older versions must use plugin v0.2.x.
problem: Glasp collects highlights and notes on the web, PDFs, YouTube and Kindle, but there is no built-in way to bring that content into Obsidian as Markdown notes and keep it up to date.

relations.evidence: Import your Glasp highlights, notes, summaries, and bookmarks — from the web and from Kindle — directly into your Obsidian vault

summary: Sync plugin that imports your Glasp web and Kindle highlights, AI summaries, and bookmarks into vault notes on a schedule.
